definitions.missing_text: the record has no stored text
definitions.blank_text: the stored text has no character Python's str.isspace() rejects
definitions.text_without_sections: non-blank text that cleaning reduces to nothing or to a notice that the text is not available
definitions.split_at_headings: bills split by the heading rule, not the window fallback
definitions.text_fetched: records whose text the text layer fetched from the legislature
definitions.text_from_bulk: records whose text came from California's bulk download
definitions.text_layer: per state, over eligible records: usable exported text (the fetch plan's kind is usable) against text that yields sections once fetched text is merged
